title: Gajendra Moksha ki Katha
playlist: Vishnu ji aur Krishna ki Kathayein
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing

scenes.prompt: A mighty elephant standing in a calm lotus lake near a green mountain, a crocodile's snout rising from the water gripping the elephant's foot, dramatic but gentle, golden morning light
scenes.tts: तालाब में मगरमच्छ ने हाथी गजेंद्र का पैर जकड़ लिया!
scenes.sub: Talaab mein magarmachh ne hathi Gajendra ka pair jakad liya!
scenes.animate: the lake water ripples softly and the camera slowly pushes in

scenes.prompt: A herd of elephants led by a majestic elephant coming down from a lush green mountain to drink at a large lotus-filled lake, warm sunrise light, peaceful forest
scenes.tts: त्रिकूट पर्वत का गजेंद्र अपने झुंड के साथ प्यास बुझाने सरोवर आया था।
scenes.sub: Trikoot parvat ka Gajendra apne jhund ke saath pyaas bujhane sarovar aaya tha.

scenes.prompt: The great elephant straining with all his strength in shallow lake water, pulling against a crocodile, other elephants watching helplessly from the shore, sad and tense mood, soft light
scenes.tts: बहुत ज़ोर लगाया, पर पकड़ ढीली न हुई। साथी भी कुछ न कर सके।
scenes.sub: Bahut zor lagaya, par pakad dheeli na hui. Saathi bhi kuch na kar sake.

scenes.prompt: The tired elephant raising a pink lotus flower high in his trunk towards the sky in prayer, standing in the lake at dusk, glowing golden sky, devotional emotion
scenes.tts: तब गजेंद्र ने सूँड़ में कमल उठाकर सच्चे मन से श्री हरि को पुकारा।
scenes.sub: Tab Gajendra ne soond mein kamal uthakar sachche man se Shri Hari ko pukara.
scenes.animate: the lotus petals sway slightly and the golden sky glows softly while the camera slowly pushes in

scenes.prompt: Lord Vishnu with blue skin, four arms holding conch, discus, mace and lotus, yellow dhoti and golden crown, arriving in the sky riding Garuda, divine golden light, serene face
scenes.tts: पुकार सुनते ही भगवान विष्णु गरुड़ पर सवार होकर पहुँच गए।
scenes.sub: Pukaar sunte hi Bhagwan Vishnu Garud par sawar hokar pahunch gaye.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the soft golden glow gently pulses, a few petals drift in the foreground

scenes.prompt: Lord Vishnu's glowing golden discus Sudarshan Chakra spinning in the air over the lake, the elephant free and safe on the shore, Vishnu's gentle blessing hand, warm divine light, no violence shown
scenes.tts: प्रभु ने सुदर्शन चक्र से गजेंद्र को छुड़ाया और उसे अपनी शरण दी।
scenes.sub: Prabhu ne Sudarshan Chakra se Gajendra ko chhudaya aur use apni sharan di.

scenes.prompt: The grateful elephant bowing his head at Lord Vishnu's lotus feet beside a lotus lake, Vishnu smiling with a blessing hand raised, glowing sunrise sky, flower petals in the air
scenes.tts: सच्चे मन की पुकार प्रभु तक पहुँचती है। यही गजेंद्र मोक्ष की सीख है।
scenes.sub: Sachche man ki pukaar Prabhu tak pahunchti hai. Yahi Gajendra Moksha ki seekh hai.

scenes.tts: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय! कल धनतेरस की कथा देखने के लिए लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें।
scenes.sub: Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya! Kal Dhanteras ki katha dekhne ke liye Like, Share aur Subscribe karein.
